dog.description_text: Teddy is just as cute and cuddly as his name implies! This little sweetheart swapped the West Coast for the East in hopes of finding his forever family. With his big smile and beautiful fur, Teddy is guaranteed to turn heads anywhere he goes. If you're looking for a pint-sized companion to fit right into your family, Teddy might just be the one!
